# Book Recommendations on the History of Mathematics

1. **"A History of Mathematics" by Carl B. Boyer and Uta C. Merzbach** - This comprehensive textbook is considered one of the most authoritative overviews of mathematical development from ancient times to the modern era. It covers major civilizations and their mathematical contributions, making it accessible to both students and general readers.

2. **"The Equation That Changed the World" by Simon Singh** - While focused on Fermat's Last Theorem, this engaging narrative explores the history of mathematics through the lens of one of its most famous problems. Singh's storytelling approach makes complex mathematical history entertaining and understandable.

3. **"Mathematics and the Real World" by Ilan Vardi** - This book explores how mathematics emerged from practical human needs and evolved into abstract theory. It provides fascinating insights into why certain mathematical concepts developed and how they shaped our understanding of the world.
